id: # Columns, the `on` grammar and driver keys: vault/architecture/guard-file-formats.md and
# vault/architecture/qg-builtin-drivers.md in the vault-quality-gates repo. quality/README.md
# describes every row in this repo. Empty cells are `-`.
# eslint, nuxt typecheck and vitest run through quality/bin/in-node.sh. Under commit it measures a
# copy of the staged tree with the main checkout's node_modules and a fresh copy of its .nuxt, so
# `pnpm install` must have run there; on push it measures this checkout as it is. jscpd 5.3.2 runs
# through an isolated `pnpm dlx`. tests-failing, coverage and coverage-age-days read the reports the
# last baseline run of tests-suite-failed left behind.

why: A commit may not add an ESLint error on the lines it adds, so lint errors only shrink.
A commit may not add a nuxt typecheck error on the lines it adds, so type errors never reach a pushed branch.
A commit may not add a line in app/ or server/ inside a block jscpd finds elsewhere, so shared logic is extracted instead of copied.

args: -- ( set -o pipefail; for e in ts vue js mjs cjs; do "{{guard}}/guard-added-lines.sh" --ext "$e" --grep 'eslint-disable|@ts-ignore|@ts-nocheck|@ts-expect-error|/\*[[:space:]]*eslint[[:space:]]' --bases "{{bases}}" --target "{{target}}" || exit 2; done | awk -v l="${GUARD_LIST:-}" 'l != "" { print; next } { s += $1 } END { if (l == "") print s + 0 }' ) || echo "suppressions-added: guard-added-lines.sh failed"
why: A commit may not add an eslint-disable, inline eslint config or @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck or @ts-expect-error comment, so a finding is fixed instead of hidden.
replaced by protected-paths-touched, which reads the longer protected list of quality/config
A commit may not change a protected gate or tool config file, so an agent cannot loosen the rules that judge it.
A commit may not change the locked version of a dev tool, an eslint plugin, nuxt or @nuxt/cli without a human override, so looser tools never arrive unseen.
The whole-repo ESLint error count may not rise above its baseline.
The whole-repo nuxt typecheck error count may not rise above its baseline.
The share of duplicated lines in app/ and server/ may not rise more than 0.1 points above its baseline.
The number of duplicated blocks in app/ and server/ may not rise above its baseline.
A push may not go out while the last whole-suite run has a failing test.
Line coverage from the last whole-suite run may not drop more than half a point below its baseline.
The whole-suite reports may be at most seven days old, so tests-failing and coverage read a recent run.
replaced by tests-suite-failed, which counts the failed tests in the junit report instead of reading the exit code
The whole suite may not fail or miss a coverage threshold on a baseline run, and it writes the reports the push rows read.
